newsitem.title: USA: Centennial Energy buys stake in Enertec.
newsitem.headline: Centennial Energy buys stake in Enertec.

text.p: Centennial Energy Partners LP and a group of other partnerships said on Friday that they have recently acquired 154,700 common shares of Enertec Resource Services Inc, raising its stake to 793,900 shares and 215,800 special warrants.
As previously announced, the purchases by Centennial Energy are for investment purposes, the partnerships said.
Centennial Energy's stake represents about 13.98 percent of Enertec's issued and outstanding common shares and warrants, it said.
